issue_request: FHIR-11003 requested renaming Questionnaire.item.initial to Questionnaire.item.prePopInfo because the element name and short description were confusing. The Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution retained the element name, changed the short description to describe a default value when first rendered, and added a comment that users may override the value unless read-only and that unchanged initial values persist into the initially created QuestionnaireResponse.
initial_application: The decision was pre-applied in 2016. Commit 76675fcc91 changed Questionnaire.item.initial's short name from "Initial presumed answer for question" to "Default value when item is first rendered". Commit 014f454e13, explicitly mentioning #11003, added the approved override/persistence comment and GF#11003 committee note in the Questionnaire spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Questionnaire is an active build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition source for Questionnaire.item.initial still carries GF#11003. Later refactoring changed the exact short description to "Initial value(s) when item is first rendered", but the neighboring definition says the values are pre-populated for rendering and the comment preserves the approved default, override, read-only, and persistence semantics. Searches found no linked Jira issue or Zulip/Confluence evidence changing this decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already conveys the approved rule, and changing only the short description back to the exact 2016 phrase would be editorial churn rather than a necessary semantic correction.
